name: wflow-platform
description: Generic declarative workflow platform on Temporal: engine, host service, visual designer and workbench.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.build:react: pnpm --filter server build && pnpm --filter web-react build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter web test && pnpm --filter web-react test
scripts.test:react: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter web-react test
scripts.test:all: pnpm --filter server test && pnpm --filter web test
scripts.type-check: pnpm --filter server type-check && pnpm --filter web-react type-check
